repos_data.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables Claude Desktop to check domain availability across 50+ TLDs. Features DNS/WHOIS verification, bulk checking, and smart suggestions. Zero-clone installation via uvx.
The fastest domain availability MCP server & free API — or the second, dispute it. Check availability across 50+ TLDs, compare 6 registrars, get domain age. No API key. By DigMyName.
